title: Account created
summary: Says that the account now lives on this phone, then opens the chat with the person who sent the invite, or the chat list when there was no invite.

inviterUserId.description: inviter_user_id from POST /v1/signup. Absent without a personal invite.

inviterHandle.description: The inviter's handle, when the invite preview had one.

phase.description: openingChat: finding or making the DM with the inviter.

appear.effect: Shows bipe_signup_device_success for a short moment (or until a tap), then runs continue.

continue.effect: With inviterUserId: opens the DM with the inviter (an existing one, else a new encrypted DM that invites the inviter) in chat-timeline, with the inviter hint. Without: opens chat-list.

notes: The inviter's phone sends the inviter's note as the first message when it learns of the join (ADR 0136). Until it arrives, the chat shows bipe_inviter_knows_you_joined (%1$s is the inviter's name) above the hint row bipe_inviter_hint with the action bipe_inviter_hint_action, which sends bipe_inviter_greeting.
A new DM is encrypted (e2ee-only-rooms) and marked as direct. Never make a second DM when one exists.
The notification permission is not asked here. It comes after the first sent message (registries/onboarding.json prompts.notifications, bipe-chat/bipe#565).
Bipe logic: BipeInviteStore.inviterGreeting and setInviterGreeting (iOS); BipeInviterGreeting, BipeDeviceAccount.takePendingInviter (Android).
